title: Landing page
prompt: Design a desktop landing page (1440 wide) for Tidepool, a tool that turns meeting recordings into a shared, searchable team memory. Hero, three feature sections, a testimonial, pricing teaser and footer.

title: Analytics dashboard
prompt: Design a desktop dashboard for a small online plant shop: revenue this week, orders, top products, a stock-low list and a recent orders table.

title: Mobile onboarding
prompt: Design a 3-screen mobile onboarding flow (phone size) for a habit app that helps people drink more water. Welcome, set a daily goal, allow reminders.

title: Settings screen
prompt: Design a desktop settings page for a note-taking app: profile, appearance (light/dark/auto), notifications toggles, connected accounts and a danger zone.

title: Pricing page
prompt: Design a desktop pricing page with three plans (Free, Team, Business), a monthly/yearly switch, a feature comparison and a short FAQ.

title: Empty states
prompt: Design empty states for a project-management app: no projects yet, no search results, and an inbox at zero. One board each, desktop, with a clear next action.
